capabilities: Consolidate the whole vault or a selected folder into one Markdown file
Generate a hierarchical table of contents with wikilinks and navigation back to the index
Strip YAML frontmatter and convert wikilinks and embeds to readable text
Extract readable text from Excalidraw notes without compressed drawing data
Exclude the config directory, .git, .trash, node_modules, and ignored folders
extras: README states it makes no network requests and processes everything locally; manual installation steps are provided alongside community plugin listing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to merge many notes into a single Markdown document that keeps navigation and is easy for AI tools to consume.
summary: Export plugin that consolidates a vault or folder into one structured Markdown document with a navigable index, optimized for AI tools.
